The error comes from the word "input" in comments, which the program checker rejects, so I removed it. I also gave the refiner more room on gain, since 43 dB is tight for a 5-transistor OTA (two-transistor diff pair, mirror load and tail source, one stage).

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "The program error is the word 'input' in comments, which the checker forbids; removed it. Kept the 5T OTA (fits the 8 uA power budget, meets swing and slew) and widened the L ranges so gain can reach 43 dB."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),       # diff pair gm/Id (weak inversion for efficiency)
    "L1":    (2.5, 1.0, 5.0),          # diff pair L (gain, flicker noise)
    "gmidp": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),        # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (2.0, 0.8, 4.0),          # PMOS load L
    "itail": (7.5e-6, 6.0e-6, 8.0e-6), # tail current (power-limited)
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),          # tail / reference mirror L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it = p["itail"]
    i1 = it / 2.0

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.35)    # diff pair
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=0.75)             # mirror load
    mref = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)               # reference diode
    mt = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], it, vds=0.35)                   # tail (same gm/Id, L)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cx = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cx)
    fz2 = 2 * fp2
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz2))
    power = vdd * (iref + it)
    slew = it / cout
    cmrr = a0 * 2 * m3.gm / max(mt.gds, 1e-12)
    psrr = a0
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 4.6 * tau + 0.3 / max(slew, 1)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    vn_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    swing = (vdd - m3.vdsat - 0.05) - (0.9 - m1.vgs + m1.vdsat + 0.05)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "power": power,
        "slew": slew,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
        "psrr_db": db(psrr),
        "settle": settle,
        "noise_1k": vn_th * 5,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
